# Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and any material limits. Explain new dependencies or changes to a shared standard.

## Verification

- [ ] `bun run verify` passed.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior and relevant failure cases, or the change does not need new behavior tests (explain why).
- [ ] Tests use isolated data; default tests make no live website/model calls.
- [ ] README, architecture and agent guidance were updated where their contracts changed.

## Manual evidence

Record desktop/mobile and keyboard checks for UI changes, including app-title casing and source-title preservation; isolated live results for extraction/model changes; and rendered-diagram review for diagram layout changes. State which checks are not applicable or unavailable and why. Include any remaining risks.
